title: χ²₁ and its 5% upper tail
caption: χ²₁ is the square of a standard normal, so χ²₁ > 3.841 exactly when |Z| > 1.96: the shaded tail beyond 3.841 has area 0.05.
alt: Graph of the χ² density with 1 degree of freedom, very tall near 0 and falling; the tail beyond 3.841 is shaded.
description: The χ²₁ density is e^(−x/2)/√(2πx): unbounded at 0 and decreasing.
The area to the right of 3.841 is 0.05, the 5% critical value.
